description: Independent baseline: Stage 2 on unpaired 50/50 original/degraded clips, natural degradation mixture, CE only
research_question: Does hard-degradation-aware training improve detection robustness and Grad-CAM explanation stability?

stage2.init: best Stage-1 checkpoint of the same (training set, seed)

curriculum.rule: epochs 1-e1 mild, e1+1-e2 +medium, later all severities; if no allowed version exists the mildest version of the source is used

stage2.clip_mix: each step: 32 clips = 16 original + 16 degraded (unpaired 5A/5B) or 16 original/degraded pairs (5C/5D)
stage2.degradation_mixture: natural: uniform over the source's verified versions; hard: with probability hard_share a hard-type version drawn from the same (dataset, class) cell

model.name: AudioVisualDeepFakeCNN
model.init: PyTorch default initialisation, seeded by the training seed (no pretrained / Test 4 weights)

model_selection: best epoch by validation score = mean(val original AUC, val degraded AUC) of the training dataset (Stage 1: val original AUC); threshold = validation balanced-accuracy optimum

evaluation.test: untouched Test 5 test split of BOTH datasets (in-domain + cross-dataset)

preprocessing.frame_sampling: 16 frames uniformly spaced over the decoded video (cv2 grab/retrieve; sequential fallback)
preprocessing.clip_frames: model clips use every 2th cached frame (evaluation averages the 2 offsets; training draws 8 random sorted frames)

crop.rule: square side = max(w,h)*(1+2*margin), clipped inside the frame, 3-frame box smoothing, nearest-detection box for frames without a face, full frame when no face in the video

preprocessing.degraded_crops: degraded videos are cropped with their SOURCE video's relative face boxes (pixel-aligned pairs)

audio.source: external .wav if present, else ffmpeg audio stream; tiled/cropped to 3 s; silent/no audio -> zero spectrogram + mask 0
audio.spectrogram: STFT n_fft 512, hop 256, win 512 Hann, log1p magnitude, bilinear 128x128, per-clip z-score clip +-3 /3

preprocessing.failed_video_handling: originals whose frames cannot be decoded are excluded before grouping (status recorded); degraded videos that fail decoding or the content-link test are excluded
preprocessing.label_independence: no preprocessing function receives a label; real and fake videos share one code path

unavoidable_differences: 5C introduces original/degraded pairing because Grad-CAM consistency needs pairs; 5C vs 5B therefore measures pairing + Grad-CAM consistency together
5D adds feature consistency AND the curriculum; 5D vs 5C measures both together
